args.body: Use the two first-party intake captures already obtained within your mission allowance. If one explicitly invites service providers and plausibly accepts a standalone link QA pilot, use the report shape readback when committed to verify the exact outcome fields and tally. Keep refused retrievals inconclusive and include the exact intake wording, route and provisional fee in the private handoff. If neither intake supports the scope, close on the source evidence without making the sample check a prerequisite. Read back the committed outcome and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external contact or publication.

description: The agency QA sample records one successful retrieval and one inconclusive result. The subsequent check failed on the report structure, so the next action will read the committed CSV and its original control to identify the mismatch. The partner intake still needs first-party evidence that it accepts this kind of work. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Treasury has CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
